caption: The drawing depicts a teapot rendered in shades of grey pencil on a cream-colored paper background. The main object, a large cylindrical teapot, is shown in a three-quarter view with a straight, elongated spout on the left, a large, curved handle on the right, and a fitted lid with a small decorative finial at the top center. The body of the teapot is decorated with a beaded edge along the top and bottom rims. At the top left of the composition, there is a small inset drawing showing a side elevation of the teapot, providing an alternative perspective. In the bottom right corner, another small inset drawing shows the top view of the teapot lid, revealing an oval shape with a central decorative knob and additional ornamentation. The drawing is enclosed within a faint rectangular border, and the name "Charles Sarjian" is inscribed in small letters in the lower left corner. The entire composition is monochromatic, utilizing varying pencil shading techniques to convey form and texture.
title: Silver Teapot
